I've been treating my Shih Tzu to Dr. Débora for 6 years, ever since she was recommended to me to save my daughter from hepatitis, and I know I owe her that. I travel from Grajaú to Leblon, and we only don't go there more often because of the distance, but we have a checkup every year and she always goes for help whenever I need it. Cacau has a complex gastrointestinal tract and doesn't take anything without Dr. Débora's authorization. We've consulted other professionals in other situations, and in the end, we always have to go back to Dr. Débora to resolve the issue. Besides that, the clinic is excellent, and we are always very well attended to by the entire team.

THEY KILLED MY SON!
THEY KILLED MY SON!
My 5-year-old son, diagnosed with a shunt... He underwent surgery guided by veterinarian DEBORA LINS, who recommended surgeon ANDREI COSTA.
They both stated that my son wouldn't have a good life expectancy with treatment alone, so he needed corrective surgery. According to them, medication wouldn't guarantee much longer.
I'm the kind of mother who asked every possible question about the risks, and at no point, NONE OF THE TIMES, was I informed that there was any risk of death.
I was told it was a simple, quick surgery and that he would only need to stay overnight for monitoring.
According to Débora, this shunt correction surgery could only be performed by a VERY EXPERIENCED surgeon to avoid any incidents.
I went to the surgery on the scheduled day and time, and as soon as the procedure was over, upon waking from the anesthesia, he woke up crying a lot. I contacted Débora and she said it was normal, they convinced me that everything was fine!
Early the next morning, before the scheduled visiting time, they called me to say that he hadn't eaten and wasn't crying anymore... When I arrived at the clinic, he really wasn't crying, he was SCREAMING. He was a little out of it and after much questioning about what was happening and after the results of the tests, they decided that it was better to undo the correction. To redo surgery in less than 24 hours, to go through anesthesia again. They convinced me it was the only way to save him, as it was already compromising other organs. I prayed, cried, made promises and my baby came out alive, calmer and with better test results. The surgeon's explanation was simply: the ring closed too quickly, SOMETHING THEY SAID WOULDN'T HAPPEN, WITH AN EXPERIENCED SURGEON LIKE HIM. She told me they could try palliative treatment to improve his quality of life without corrective surgery (something that wasn't discussed beforehand, after all, surgery was the only option given). Also, to my surprise, they were wrong to think that other organs were compromised, everything was fine! And although everything was better, Débora kept saying to keep praying, because all these procedures were a risk for him, after all, there were two surgeries, right? And yes, my little boy passed away the next morning. And who notified us? The on-call doctor who may have fallen asleep and didn't even know exactly when he took his last breath...
I had the surgery two weeks after the diagnosis, because as Débora advised, the sooner the better! That two weeks was enough for him to no longer have neurological symptoms resulting from the disease. I counted exactly two weeks, but after a lot of research and conversations with other professionals, I discovered that at least two months of treatment should have been done. I also discovered what I already knew: that the ring closing quickly is a real mistake, so THE PROFESSIONAL NEEDS TO KNOW WHAT THEY ARE DOING. I wonder if that's why they didn't want to undo it, for fear that I would want to investigate the death further, with the ring placed incorrectly. It was better to KILL my son, subject him to another surgery, telling me again that it was the only option.
Lack of clear explanations about the procedure, the treatment, and the risks. I don't wish what I'm going through on anyone... DON'T TRUST THEM!

The clinic used to be very good, I even gave it a 5-star rating, but it has declined considerably in recent times, and it is with immense regret that I am revising my review.
The consultation and exam fees are high for a poor response.
There is no commitment to the pet's health, especially when it comes to providing feedback when the exams don't come back on the same day. I felt cheated paying over R$1300 last time to have all the necessary exams done, and Dr. Debora guaranteed that she would contact me the next day with an update. I had to complain to the clinic, which only sends the exams but doesn't provide feedback on medications or to say how things are going. Do I need to know how to read the exams now? Or is there an additional cost for that too?! This is the second time this has happened, and I am very upset. If I don't make a "scene," nothing happens. They may be very attentive during the consultation, but it feels like you swipe your card and leave, and you completely lose the value to them.
